items.title: 8.2 Cultural and Ethical Implications of AI Systems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 8.2: the text before its first sub-heading (PDF 112-113, printed 108-109).

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) logon ke rehne, kaam karne aur technology se taalluq par asar dalti hai, is liye is ke cultural (saqafati) aur ethical (akhlaqi) asraat ko dekhna zaroori hai. AI systems sirf technical cheezein nahi, balke samaji tools bhi hain jo logon, bastiyon (communities) aur hukoomaton par asar dalte hain (Figure 8.5).

blocks.alt: Darmiyani daira 'AI system' chaar stakeholders se jura: developers (durust, munsif systems), users (asani, raazdari, durust nataij), hukoomatein (qawaneen, awami mafad) aur biradariyan (samaji aur saqafati aqdar). Neeche patti usool: insaf (imtiyaz nahi), jawabdehi (koi zimmedar), shaffafiyat (faisle samjhaye ja sakein) aur hifazat (users ko nuqsan nahi).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.5: Akhlaqi AI design mukhtalif stakeholders ke mafadat mein tawazun rakhta hai aur insaf aur shamooliyat yaqeeni banata hai (kitab ki Figure 8.5 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Akhlaqi design ka matlab chaaron groups ka tawazun hai, sirf system banane ya paisa dene walon ka nahi.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Mubahisa (debate): “Kya AI ko aise faisle karne chahiye jo logon ki zindagi par asar dalein, jaise naukri ke liye bharti ya talaba ko grade dena?”

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hamari Figure 8.5 mein beech mein AI system hai aur us se chaar stakeholders jure hain: developers (durust aur munsifana system), users (aasani, privacy, sahi nateeja), governments (qanoon, awam ka faida) aur communities (samaji aur saqafati aqdar). Neeche wali patti chaar usool dikhati hai: fairness, accountability, transparency aur safety. Matlab: achha AI sab ke mafadat ka tawazun rakhta hai aur kisi ko bahar nahi chhorta (inclusivity).

blocks.prompt: Kitab ke mutabiq AI systems sirf technical cheez kyun nahi hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh samaji tools (social tools) bhi hain jo logon, communities aur hukoomaton par asar dalte hain; is liye in ke saqafati (cultural) aur akhlaqi (ethical) asraat dekhna zaroori hai.

items: AI logon ke rehne, kaam aur rabte par asar dalti hai.
Is liye saqafati aur akhlaqi asraat ka jaiza zaroori hai (Figure 8.5).
